title: hypericum ciliatum var. heldreichii
intro: Hypericum ciliatum var. heldreichii, commonly known as the Balkan St. John's Wort, is a plant species belonging to the Hypericum genus. This herb has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as antiviral, antibacterial, and anti-inflammatory effects, contributing to the relief of anxiety and insomnia. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum ciliatum var. heldreichii include its ability to modulate the nervous system, acting as a sedative, and exhibiting antioxidant properties. The plant's bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and naphthoquinones, which are responsible for its pharmacological activities.
